authority: Author requested four additional biological-resource brainstorm entries in the inventory visualizer.
boundary: Raw harvested materials only. Species, anatomy, processing, yield and performance remain proposals. No recipes, gameplay effects, general edibility or free water are established.

items.name: Faunal gripping-pad scales
items.purpose: Candidate textured feed for tool grips, foot-contact surfaces and cargo-rest friction pads.
items.acquisition: Gather naturally shed or recover intact gripping-pad scales from a selected fauna species; anatomy and collection method proposed.
items.processing: Sort intact textured faces for later trimming and backing trials. No adhesive, attachment method or recipe assigned.
items.limitations: Grip under dust, wear rate and safe preparation remain untested. Not a finished boot sole or guaranteed climbing aid.
items.aliases: grip scales; traction pad; footpad lamellae
items.distinction: Naturally textured contact faces, rather than structural shell plates, wing membranes or raw hide.

items.name: Faunal resonance plates
items.purpose: Candidate thin resonating feed for mechanical sounders, rattles and acoustic instrument experiments.
items.acquisition: Recover intact dry plates from a proposed sound-producing structure in selected fauna; species and anatomy unresolved.
items.processing: Inspect for cracks and sort by dimensions before resonance trials. No tuning process or finished instrument recipe assigned.
items.limitations: Frequency, loudness and durability remain undefined. No electrical sensing, supernatural resonance or guaranteed lure effect.
items.aliases: sound plate; stridulation plate; resonating shell
items.distinction: Selected for acoustic response, rather than the bulk structural use of ordinary shell plates.

items.name: Faunal grinding grit
items.purpose: Candidate mineral-rich abrasive feed for surface finishing and workshop polishing trials.
items.acquisition: Recover loose hard granules from a proposed internal grinding chamber in selected fauna; species, anatomy and yield unresolved.
items.processing: Segregate contaminated material and assess dry grading and containment before abrasive trials. No decontamination process or recipe assigned.
items.limitations: Internal faunal residues may be toxic. Hardness, contamination and safe processing remain unknown; not food or a finished abrasive disc.
items.aliases: grinding granules; gut grit; biological abrasive feed
items.distinction: Solid mechanically recovered grit, separate from digestive etchant, droppings and geological sand.

items.name: Mineralized hinge rods
items.purpose: Candidate slender hard-part blanks for small mechanical pivots and hinge-pin fitting trials.
items.acquisition: Recover straight mineralized rods from a proposed articulating mouthpart in selected fauna; species and extraction method unresolved.
items.processing: Inspect for cracks and grade by straightness and diameter before fitting trials. No precision machining or component recipe assigned.
items.limitations: Brittleness, tolerances and load capacity remain unverified. Not a finished replacement joint pin or approved load-bearing component.
items.aliases: faunal pivot rod; mouthpart hinge rod; mineralized pin blank
items.distinction: Straight pivot blanks, separate from joint-socket cups, claw tips, horn cores and manufactured joint pins.
